# Set Up Shop Online

> Business diagnosis, AI consulting, solution architecture, and implementation guidance for established service businesses. Handle more work profitably, create capacity, and reduce owner dependence.

Vlad Gutenmakher is the founder of Set Up Shop Online Inc. and an AI Consultant and Value Architect. He brings more than 35 years of experience across technology, engineering, solution architecture, technical sales, consulting, and implementation, plus approximately 20 years of entrepreneurship.

The approach is Diagnose, Prioritize, Architect, Implement, and Measure. AI and agentic systems are used where they create meaningful business value. Service scope and success measures are agreed for each engagement.

## Business and services

- [Home](https://setupshoponline.com/): Positioning, approach, and who we help.

- [Services](https://setupshoponline.com/products-services-solutions#services): Assessment, architecture, coaching, training, implementation leadership, and ongoing advisory.
- [Solutions](https://setupshoponline.com/products-services-solutions#solutions): The SUSO Framework, agentic workflows, business knowledge systems, integrations, analytics, governance, security, and marketing solutions.
- [Why Vlad](https://setupshoponline.com/why-setupshoponline): Background, experience, and consulting approach.

## Getting started

- [Free Business Strategy Report](https://setupshoponline.com/free-business-strategy): Choose one of six business priorities and answer ten questions for an AI-generated report with findings and a 30–60–90-day plan. No purchase or call required.
- [15-minute intro](https://setupshoponline.com/book-a-call): Share a priority, ask questions, and discuss fit and the next step. The intro does not include a written assessment or implementation. A one-hour AI Strategy Session is a separate service.
- [Book an intro](https://calendly.com/meet_with_setupshoponline/15-minute-intro): Scheduling for products, services, and solutions.
- [Contact](https://setupshoponline.com/contact-us): Inquiry form and business contact information.

## Services

Expert guidance and practical implementation to identify valuable opportunities, put your business knowledge to work, and help your people use AI with confidence.

### 1 on 1 Team Member Training: Build AI Skills Around Real Work

https://setupshoponline.com/products-services-solutions#individual-ai-training

Help each employee apply AI to their actual responsibilities with practical skills, confidence, and clear review habits.

Training focuses on the tasks the person performs, the standards their work must meet, and the tools they can use. We practice relevant examples, develop reusable approaches, and show how to check results before relying on them.

The employee leaves with techniques they can apply in their role and a clearer understanding of when human judgment is needed.

Best for: Employees who need individual practice tied to their role and quality standards.

Value to measure: Task completion time, output quality, rework, and sustained use of the new skills.

### Business Context Integration and Prompt Systems: Turn What Your Business Knows Into Better Results

https://setupshoponline.com/products-services-solutions#business-context-prompt-systems

Connect existing information with practical AI systems and tested prompts to reduce research, repeated explanations, and rework.

Your business already holds valuable context in documents, meeting notes, customer records, procedures, and everyday decisions. We identify the sources that matter to a selected workflow, organize the relevant information, and integrate it into a practical system your team can use.

We build reusable prompts and instructions around your standards, customers, and goals, then test them against real tasks such as preparing proposals, responding to clients, onboarding employees, or producing reports.

Within the agreed scope, you receive a source and context map, a working context-supported workflow, a tested prompt library, and guidance for reviewing outputs and keeping information current.

The focus is making your existing knowledge useful at the moment work happens, with clear ownership of updates and appropriate access to source material.

Best for: Businesses whose teams repeatedly search for information, explain the same context to AI, or correct generic outputs.

Value to measure: Time spent finding and preparing information, task completion time, output quality, review effort, rework, and adoption of the shared system.

### Operational Workflow and Agentic Systems Architecture

https://setupshoponline.com/products-services-solutions#operational-workflow-and-agentic-systems-architecture

We map the future workflow and define its trigger, objective, inputs, steps, decisions, systems, handoffs, exceptions, and completion criteria. We specify what stays with people, what follows fixed automation rules, and where AI or an agent may be useful.

The design addresses information access, permitted actions, approvals, escalation routes, integration requirements, ownership, and measurement. It gives your team and implementation partners a shared basis for building and testing.

This offer develops the workflow and system design. Existing Agentic Orchestration Enablement remains available for enabling coordinated agents and workflows.

### SUSO Framework: Map Business Value, Design the Solution, Build the First Version

https://setupshoponline.com/products-services-solutions#suso-framework

Turn a priority opportunity into a business case, solution architecture, and a Phase 1 or MVP prototype.

Our Value Mapping and Solution Architecture process connects your goals to the people, workflows, and information that shape results. We establish a baseline, identify opportunities, and prioritize them by value, cost, effort, and feasibility.

Within the agreed scope, you receive a value map, phased plan, solution architecture, and a working Phase 1 or minimum viable product prototype, with testing and handoff guidance. Depending on complexity, we may also publish a live version if testing and client acceptance can be completed within the agreed timeframe.

Best for: Businesses ready for deeper assessment, solution design, and a first working prototype.

Value to measure: A documented business case, a testable first version, and agreed measures for capacity, quality, customer experience, or financial performance.

Start with a 15 minute intro call to discuss your business challenge and whether the SUSO Framework fits your goals. Choose a time on the next screen.

## Solutions

Connected capabilities that help your business win work, improve operations, protect information, turn knowledge into reusable assets, and make better decisions.

### Agentic Orchestration Enablement: Move Work Forward Across People and Systems

https://setupshoponline.com/products-services-solutions#agentic-orchestration

Coordinate AI agents and workflows to reduce manual handoffs while keeping responsibilities and approvals clear.

When a process spans several tools or teams, useful work can stall between steps. We help design and enable coordinated agents and workflows with defined tasks, connections, human approval points, and monitoring.

Start with a bounded use case and build on what testing shows. The result is a clearer path for information and work to move, with people retaining control over the decisions assigned to them.

Best for: Businesses with a defined process that would benefit from coordinated agents and systems.

Value to measure: Workflow completion time, manual handoffs, exception rates, and human review effort.

Start with a 15 minute intro call to discuss a workflow you want to improve and where human review needs to stay involved. Choose a time on the next screen.

Next step: https://calendly.com/meet_with_setupshoponline/15-minute-intro



### Agentic Workflow Pilot

https://setupshoponline.com/products-services-solutions#agentic-workflow-pilot

A promising workflow needs practical evidence before a larger commitment.

We select one bounded use case, establish a baseline, and test a controlled version with defined information sources, permissions, human review, exception handling, and success measures.

Possible starting points include service-request coordination, information retrieval, customer-update preparation, service-report processing, follow-up management, and exception identification. The right choice depends on your workflow and readiness.

The pilot tests usefulness, reliability, review effort, adoption, and business value. Its results inform whether to improve, expand, or stop.

This pilot tests one agreed use case. It complements existing Agentic Orchestration Enablement and does not replace the Phase 1 or MVP included in an agreed SUSO Framework package.

Start with a 15-minute intro to discuss your priority and whether this is the right next step.

Next step: https://calendly.com/meet_with_setupshoponline/15-minute-intro

### AI Business Brains and Marketplace Knowledge Products: Put Your Expertise to Work Inside Your Business and Beyond

https://setupshoponline.com/products-services-solutions#ai-business-brains

Build a reusable AI brain that helps your team apply company knowledge, or package your expertise into a knowledge product designed for marketplace sales.

Your experience, methods, and business knowledge can become an asset people use repeatedly. Building on our work with Mygentic, we help turn approved source material into a focused AI brain with a clear audience, useful capabilities, and a practical plan for testing and ongoing improvement.

Internal Business Brain

Give employees a consistent way to find and apply your processes, service standards, product knowledge, training, and lessons learned.

We organize the knowledge around real questions and tasks, define how the brain should respond, and test its usefulness with the people who will use it. The aim is faster onboarding, fewer repeated questions, more consistent work, and less dependence on one person holding all the answers.

Marketplace Knowledge Product

Turn expertise you own or are authorized to commercialize into a focused brain for a defined buyer and business problem.

We help shape the offer, organize the knowledge, develop useful prompts and guided experiences, test representative tasks, and prepare product descriptions, demonstrations, and onboarding materials.

Marketplace preparation includes planning access, support, and updates. Publication follows the selected platform’s requirements and your approval. Private company and client information stays separate from the material intended for sale.

Within the agreed scope, the work includes an audience and use-case brief, a knowledge map, a working brain prototype, testing criteria, and an ownership and update plan. The internal path focuses on business adoption. The marketplace path also considers buyer demand, delivery costs, and the effort required to support customers.

Best for: Businesses that want to preserve and share institutional knowledge, and experts or firms that want to turn authorized expertise into a repeatable product.

Value to measure: For internal use: time to find answers, onboarding effort, answer quality, adoption, and expert time recovered.

Value to measure: For marketplace products: validated buyer interest, activation, repeat use, sales conversion, revenue, support costs, and contribution margin.

Start with a 15 minute intro call to discuss how your expertise could support your team or become a knowledge product. Choose a time on the next screen.

Next step: https://calendly.com/meet_with_setupshoponline/15-minute-intro

## About Vlad Gutenmakher

Practical judgment from discovery through implementation

I help established service businesses handle more work profitably, without overhead growing at the same pace or the owner having to hold everything together.

Growth can expose gaps in the way people, information, and systems work together. My role is to understand those gaps, determine which improvements are worth making, and help turn the right design into a useful operating capability.

An architect’s perspective and an owner’s experience

My background spans more than 35 years across technology, engineering, solution architecture, technical sales, consulting, and implementation. I have also spent approximately 20 years building and operating my own business.

That combination helps me work with owners, operational teams, developers, and vendors while keeping the business outcome in view. I understand that a technically possible idea still has to fit your people, budget, systems, and priorities.

Principles

Start with the constraint — Understand what is making growth harder before choosing a tool.

Use what already works — Consider process changes and existing-system improvements alongside new technology.

Define responsibility — Make it clear what people own, what systems can do, and when a person must step in.

Carry the design into practice — Connect requirements, implementation decisions, testing, and adoption.

Measure useful change — Agree on a baseline and review outcomes before expanding the solution.

Let’s understand what would make the business easier to grow

If your team is busy but more work keeps creating more overhead or owner involvement, start with the free assessment or book a 15-minute intro to discuss your next step.
